_doc: The Metanoia homeworld, LHS 1140 b (story/STORY.md; planets.json id homeworld, intro 'scan'). thales: the first Vessel, a fixed character with a mind (a replicants row with traits.thales, never handed over, never held): his name, body from the parts kit, visor light (palette index), voice, temperament, and the word he says at the opening (line). He keeps near his unfinished work (keepPx). founded: the Metanoia structures standing when the game starts, placed on the town's civic lots in order (Building blueprints, buildings.json): built ones are finished; progress 0..1 is how far Thales got with one; cost: what it still waits for (the beginning, story/STORY.md: salt, iron, wood and Ember from the homeworld, copper and quartz from Gliese 12 b, planets.json lacks). Once the store covers it the supplies fly from the hatch into its printer (printer.feedMs) and the printer lays the rest on its own, a layer every printer.layerMs (swings still lay one each). goal: the founded structure the opening points you to. playerNumber: which Vessel the first player is (the tenth, story/STORY.md: nine were awoken before and spread far); it is called THALES X until it names itself. intro: the opening's timings in ms (scan sweep, the pause before Thales speaks, the visor flicker after the box closes).

wants.text: See the work I began on the homeworld finished.
Watch the copies I make become themselves.

founded.name: Thales' Hall
founded.purpose: Where Thales began: the first room the Metanoia's Vessels raised on the homeworld.

founded.name: Printworks
founded.purpose: A house for the printers, half printed when Thales stopped.

founded.name: Archive
founded.purpose: Where the Metanoia kept the record of who they were.
